goal.zh: 把不同优化方法接入共享约束、候选来源、反馈与恢复流程。
goal.en: Connect optimization methods through shared constraints, candidate provenance, feedback and recovery.

constraints.zh: 优化器主要覆盖序列梯度与局部扩散；工程验证尚未完成。
constraints.en: The optimizer covers sequence gradients and local diffusion; engineering validation remains incomplete.

next_step.zh: 补齐验收结果，再推进下一阶段。
next_step.en: Complete acceptance before moving to the next stage.

label.zh: 序列梯度优化：借助模型反馈逐步调整序列表示，并遵守预先声明的约束。
label.en: Sequence-gradient optimization: adjust a sequence representation using model feedback within declared constraints.

label.zh: 局部扩散：在已有候选附近探索受约束的局部变化。
label.en: Local diffusion: explore constrained local changes around an existing candidate.

label.zh: 突变扫描：比较有界的单点或组合变化。
label.en: Mutation scanning: compare bounded single or combined changes.

label.zh: 骨架条件 MPNN：以给定骨架为条件生成序列候选。
label.en: Backbone-conditioned MPNN: generate candidate sequences conditioned on a backbone.

label.zh: MPNN 与 FastRelax：结合序列采样和结构松弛；计算评分需要独立评估。
label.en: MPNN plus FastRelax: combine sequence sampling and structural relaxation; computational scores need independent evaluation.

goal.zh: 避免为名称查询重复构建无关信息，同时保留校验边界。
goal.en: Avoid constructing unused information for name queries while preserving validation boundaries.

constraints.zh: 变更尚未合并，新版本仍待验证。
constraints.en: The change is not merged; the new version remains unverified.

next_step.zh: 补齐验收结果，再推进下一阶段。
next_step.en: Complete acceptance before moving to the next stage.

goal.zh: 让检查在明确指定源码范围时正确定位共享工具。
goal.en: Resolve shared validation tools correctly for an explicitly selected source scope.

constraints.zh: 代码已合并；不代表全部下游任务已交付。
constraints.en: Code is merged; this does not establish delivery of every downstream task.

next_step.zh: 补齐验收结果，再推进下一阶段。
next_step.en: Complete acceptance before moving to the next stage.

campaign.zh: 个人操作工具与可靠性

goal.zh: 完善有界查询、去重检查和操作后确认，让不完整结果保持未知。
goal.en: Improve bounded queries, duplicate checks and operation readback while keeping incomplete results unknown.

constraints.zh: 代码已合并，设备部署状态待确认。
constraints.en: Code is merged; device deployment remains unconfirmed.

next_step.zh: 补齐验收结果，再推进下一阶段。
next_step.en: Complete acceptance before moving to the next stage.

campaign.zh: 个人操作工具与可靠性

goal.zh: 修正取消、审批顺序与回执确认，保留不确定操作并避免重复发送。
goal.en: Correct cancellation, approval ordering and receipt validation; preserve uncertain operations without replay.

constraints.zh: 代码已合并，运行验证待补充。
constraints.en: Code is merged; runtime validation remains pending.

next_step.zh: 补齐验收结果，再推进下一阶段。
next_step.en: Complete acceptance before moving to the next stage.

campaign.zh: 个人操作工具与可靠性

title.zh: 安装中断后的恢复边界

goal.zh: 首次安装被中断后的恢复方式，需要明确所有权与人工决策。
goal.en: Recovery from an interrupted first installation needs explicit ownership rules and an operator decision.

constraints.zh: 待决策；不代表已运行服务出现故障。
constraints.en: Decision pending; this does not imply a failure in running services.

next_step.zh: 补齐验收结果，再推进下一阶段。
next_step.en: Complete acceptance before moving to the next stage.

goal.zh: 围绕性质预测方法的上下文使用与证据整理开展研究变更。
goal.en: Develop research changes around contextual use of property prediction methods and supporting evidence.

constraints.zh: 研究受阻，科学验证尚未完成。
constraints.en: Research is blocked; scientific validation remains incomplete.

next_step.zh: 解决当前阻碍，完成验收。
next_step.en: Resolve the blockers and complete acceptance.

label.zh: 上下文学习：以给定参考样本为条件进行预测，适用性须由明确的对照验证。
label.en: In-context learning: predict conditioned on reference examples; applicability requires explicit controlled evaluation.

title.zh: 测试收集与回放资格检查

goal.zh: 改进测试收集与保留记录的回放资格检查，让证据范围保持可追溯。
goal.en: Improve test collection and qualification of retained replay records so evidence scope remains traceable.

constraints.en: The current change has not passed acceptance.

next_step.zh: 解决当前阻碍，完成验收。
next_step.en: Resolve the blockers and complete acceptance.
